column1: # American -> British ("-ise") spellings, one per line: american<TAB>british, lower case.
# Matching ignores case and keeps the original's capitalisation (Armor -> Armour).
# Derived from VarCon (Variant Conversion Info) 2016.01.19, limited to words that occur in
# the game's strings, then checked by hand; see README.md for its notice.
# Words whose British spelling depends on their sense (meter/metre, tire/tyre,
# licence, practise) are listed here only where every use in the game takes the
# British form; protected phrases are in keep.txt.
